title: Higher moment bound for a low degree projection
statement: Let $n,k\in\mathbb N$, let $g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$, and let $q,\rho\in\mathbb R$ satisfy $q\ge2$ and $0<\rho\le1$. On the Boolean cube with uniform measure, the $q$-moment norm of the Fourier truncation of $g$ to sets of size at most $k$ is at most $(\sqrt{q-1}/\rho)^k$ times the $q$-moment norm of the noise operator with parameter $\rho$ applied to $g$.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ be a function on the uniform Boolean cube, $k\in\mathbb N$, $q\ge2$, and $0<\rho\le1$. Then $\|f^{\le k}\|_q\le(\sqrt{q-1}/\rho)^k\|T_\rho f\|_q$.
